title: Edit Decisions
description: Editorial decisions produced by the Edit Agent.

source.description: Source file path or asset-manifest ID

layer.description: Track routing on the FFmpeg render path (first multi-track step; the Mission Control editor's layer dropdown writes this). 'overlay' lifts the cut OUT of the base concat and composites it as a timed picture-in-picture video overlay: it starts at the project time where it sits in cuts[] order (accumulated duration of the primary/background cuts listed before it), runs for (out-in)/speed, is sized by transform.scale as a fraction of canvas width (default 0.30), and placed by transform.position as a named anchor (default top-right). Its audio is NOT mixed — use overlays[].audio_mix for that. 'primary'/'background'/absent concatenate on the base track (unchanged behavior).

scale.description: Primary-cut box size on the canvas. A uniform number (fraction of canvas, default 1.0) OR a per-axis {x,y} object for a non-uniform box, e.g. a split-screen panel = {"x":1.0,"y":0.5} (full width, half height). The clip fits INSIDE the box aspect-preserved (never stretched); to FILL a non-uniform box, pre-shape the source aspect with transform.crop.

position.description: Primary-cut placement on the canvas. A named anchor string (default 'center', flush to edges) OR an {x,y} object = clip box top-left in canvas px. layer='overlay' (PiP) cuts MUST use a named-anchor string (the renderer rejects {x,y} there).

animation.description: Motion applied to still images (e.g. ken-burns-slow-zoom, pan-left, static)

transition_in.description: Transition type entering this cut (e.g. fade, dissolve, cut, wipe)

type.description: Overlay kind. Absent/'image'/'video' = asset-backed overlay (requires asset_id + position). 'text' renders via FFmpeg drawtext (requires text; asset_id not needed). Text overlays are an FFmpeg-runtime feature.

text.description: Text content for type='text'. Special characters (colons, quotes, commas, %) are escaped by the renderer; %{...} expansion is disabled.

font_path.description: Optional .ttf/.ttc font file for type='text'. Default resolves a bold sans from common system font dirs (same candidate list as text_card_gen).

color.description: Text color for type='text' (ffmpeg color: name, #RRGGBB, or 0xRRGGBB[AA]).

box.description: Background box behind the text (type='text' only).

position.description: Pixel position object, or (text overlays only) a named anchor string. Text overlays default to bottom-center when omitted.

track.description: Overlay track / z-layer. Overlays composite in ascending track order, so a HIGHER track lands on top (rendered later); within one track, array order breaks ties. Default 0 reproduces legacy array-order z-stacking — older docs without this field are unaffected.

audio_mix.description: Mix the overlay source's own audio into the base track. FFmpeg path: trimmed to the overlay window, delayed to start_seconds, amix duration=first (base length wins). Skipped with a warning when the source has no audio stream.

keyframes.description: Per-overlay motion timeline. Each keyframe sets the layer's transform/opacity at an absolute project time `t` (seconds). The renderer interpolates between consecutive keyframes using the `easing` of the earlier one. Omit for a static overlay (back-compatible). Text overlays honor x/y/opacity keyframes only (scale/rotation are warned and ignored on the drawtext path).

t.description: Absolute project time in seconds (same axis as start_seconds)

easing.description: Interpolation curve toward the NEXT keyframe

audio.description: Audio configuration for narration, music, and SFX.

path.description: Pre-mixed master audio track muxed over the assembled video (e.g. a talking head's continuous original VO). When set, it becomes the output's audio — the per-cut/segment audio is overridden — so it must span the full timeline. Read by the FFmpeg render path (video_compose _render_via_ffmpeg → _compose audio_path).

music.description: Music bed(s). A SINGLE region object (one bed — the legacy shape) OR an ARRAY of region objects (multiple beds, e.g. after a split on the timeline). Each region carries an optional [start_seconds, end_seconds] window (defaults to the whole timeline) so it can be trimmed/moved/split like an overlay. Readers normalize both forms to a list.

source.description: Path to subtitle file or asset ID

color.description: Primary text color (hex or ASS format)

music.description: Legacy top-level music config. Prefer audio.music for new pipelines.

transitions.description: Global transition list. Per-cut transitions in cuts[].transition_in/out are preferred.

renderer_family.description: Locked at proposal stage — creative grammar for this deliverable. Preserved from proposal_packet; edit MUST NOT change without a logged decision. NOTE: video_compose._get_composition_id (RENDERER_FAMILY_MAP) RAISES on an unrecognized value — adding an enum value here is NOT sufficient on its own; a matching RENDERER_FAMILY_MAP entry + a real Remotion composition must exist before any artifact emits it. 'social-reel' is reserved for the instagram-reels-studio pipeline (Phase 2).

render_runtime.description: Locked at proposal stage — technical runtime that realizes renderer_family. Edit MUST carry this forward unchanged unless a logged render_runtime_selection decision overrides it.

compose_target.description: Output canvas for the FFmpeg compose path. Precedence: compose_target > profile-resolved resolution > 1920x1080@30. Width/height must be even (yuv420p).

background.description: Project background composited BEHIND all primary cuts on the FFmpeg compose path. Absent ⇒ solid black (byte-identical to legacy). 'color' fills the uncovered canvas; 'image' covers it (object-fit: cover). Applied only on the proxy-assemble pass — never baked into a scene proxy.

asset_id.description: Manifest id (or path) of the background image for type='image'.

default_transition_duration.description: Global default duration (seconds) for cuts[].transition_in/out when a cut omits transition_duration. FFmpeg xfade path clamps all transition durations to [0.1, 2.0]. Default 0.5.

musicRegion.description: One music bed spanning an optional [start_seconds, end_seconds] window on the timeline.

end_seconds.description: Project time this bed ends (default: end of the timeline). The music is truncated here on render.
